title: What's the point of what's your prompt?
author: Kingnorik
selftext:
Whenever this is asked in any thread I roll my eyes. Asking for the prompt to me is just like so lazy to me, personally. Unless you're using Midjourney where there are like codewords. Part of the fun and the use of AI is getting it to do anything what you want, so like describe what you want?

Plus just using a prompt for images doesn't even work. The AI goes off the convo and needs all the things that led to the prompt for those results. And lastly you could literally just copy and paste the image and your AI will tell you a prompt to use. /Rantover

comments.author: iElementals
comments.body: Its probably FOMO, people just dont want to fall behind or missing out on the best possible outcome. Theres also people that has a big idea but dont know how to put it down on paper.

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: But like AI has already removed 90% of the barrier. Surely you can get the other 10%.

comments.author: mechatui
comments.body: People wanna copy what you have done basically but they are so braindead they can’t even come up with a prompt. You also see these same people asking what sad product or game they should make or what features should I add.

comments.author: doudou262
comments.body: I get the eye-roll, but I think most folks aren't being lazy, they're just trying to learn the language. A prompt alone won't copy a result, you're right about that — the back-and-forth matters more. Still, seeing how someone described light, lens, or style gives beginners a starting vocabulary. Maybe a better ask is 'how did you get there?' That shares the thinking, not just the final line.

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: No, I really don't get it. A prompt literally does not make it easier to get AI to do something. Look it up. And plus you can just talk to the AI to get what you want. I've made a lot of things with AI. Like a lot. Like released games.

replies.author: Sea-Trouble9603
replies.body: I think you are right, you really dont get it

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: Please tell me. I have no ill will, I'm not being factitious at all. I don't care about karma numbers.
